flags.message: documents.json lists a single kind='brief-in-opposition' document (entry_date Aug 03 2026, 72 pages) whose URL field concatenates two filings: the Feb 13 2026 brief in opposition and the Aug 03 2026 respondent's brief on the merits. The content was usable (both texts present, clearly delimited), but the kind/date labeling understates what the file is — a briefed-moment merits cell reading only the 'kind' would think it had no merits brief.
